Our story

Slow-cooked recipes,
served under a sky full of lights.

At Village Side, dinner is an unhurried thing. Guests kick off their shoes, settle onto a khatiya, and share plates of drums of heaven, peanut masala, and steaming tandoori under lantern light. Everything you'd expect at a village dawat — nothing you wouldn't.

The vibe

Open-air, lantern-lit, softly loud.

Reviewers keep saying the same three things: the food tastes like home, the staff treat you like family, and the courtyard at night is something you'll want to photograph. We agree.

  • Khatiya (traditional cot) seating for groups
  • Live-fire tandoor and open kitchen
  • Family & birthday celebrations welcome
  • Ample parking · dine-in · reservations
